dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Thanks, it's always nice to get positive feedback. This is more than just a mill — the tofu we make here is the best in all of Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I know that sounds like bragging, but it's the truth. Many restaurants in Liyue Harbor order from us, and so does the Wangshu Inn!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Of course, I could talk all day but nothing beats trying it for yourself. Here, have some on the house. If you like it, maybe you can consider buying some more in the future.
